```{r echo=FALSE}
## Define  interaction table functions {-}

compact_emm_table <- function(emm_object,
                              by_var,
                              condition_prefix = NULL,
                              digits_est = 2,
                              digits_df = 1,
                              digits_p = 3) {
  
  by_var_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(by_var))
  
  emm_df <- summary(emm_object) |> as.data.frame()
  contrast_df <- pairs(emm_object) |> summary() |> as.data.frame()
  
  # Exclude BOTH Satterthwaite/KR-style and asymptotic-style CI/df column names
  non_focal_cols <- c(by_var_name, "emmean", "SE", "df",
                      "lower.CL", "upper.CL",
                      "asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL")
  
  focal_vars <- setdiff(names(emm_df), non_focal_cols)
  
  # Detect whichever CI column names are actually present
  lcl_col <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(emm_df))
  ucl_col <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(emm_df))
  
  emm_part <- emm_df |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste(c_across(all_of(focal_vars)), collapse = " "),
      Condition = if (is.null(condition_prefix)) {
        as.character(.data[[by_var_name]])
      } else {
        paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]])
      }
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = if (length(lcl_col) > 0) .data[[lcl_col]] else NA_real_,
      upper.CL = if (length(ucl_col) > 0) .data[[ucl_col]] else NA_real_,
      t.ratio = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_
    )
  
  # Detect whichever test-statistic column name is present (t.ratio vs z.ratio)
  ratio_col <- intersect(c("t.ratio", "z.ratio"), names(contrast_df))
  
  contrast_part <- contrast_df |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = contrast,
      Condition = if (is.null(condition_prefix)) {
        as.character(.data[[by_var_name]])
      } else {
        paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]])
      }
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio = if (length(ratio_col) > 0) .data[[ratio_col]] else NA_real_,
      p.value
    )
  
  bind_rows(emm_part, contrast_part) |>
    arrange(Condition, Comparison) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    )
}

compact_3way_table <- function(emm_object,
                               by_var,
                               condition_prefix = NULL,
                               factor1,
                               factor2,
                               digits_est = 2,
                               digits_df = 1,
                               digits_p = 3) {
  
  by_var_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(by_var))
  factor1_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(factor1))
  factor2_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(factor2))
  
  emm_df <- summary(emm_object) |>
    as.data.frame()
  
  make_condition <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(condition_prefix)) {
      as.character(x[[by_var_name]])
    } else {
      paste(condition_prefix, "=", x[[by_var_name]])
    }
  }
  
  emm_part <- emm_df |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste(.data[[factor1_name]], .data[[factor2_name]]),
      Condition = make_condition(cur_data())
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_
    )
  
  factor1_part <- pairs(emm_object, simple = factor1_name) |>
    summary() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = contrast,
      Condition = paste(
        if (is.null(condition_prefix)) .data[[by_var_name]] else paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]]),
        "|",
        factor2_name, "=",
        .data[[factor2_name]]
      )
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio,
      p.value
    )
  
  factor2_part <- pairs(emm_object, simple = factor2_name) |>
    summary() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = contrast,
      Condition = paste(
        if (is.null(condition_prefix)) .data[[by_var_name]] else paste(condition_prefix, "=", .data[[by_var_name]]),
        "|",
        factor1_name, "=",
        .data[[factor1_name]]
      )
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio,
      p.value
    )
  
  interaction_part <- contrast(
    emm_object,
    interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise")
  ) |>
    summary() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste0(
        "Int: ",
        .data[[paste0(factor1_name, "_pairwise")]],
        " across ",
        .data[[paste0(factor2_name, "_pairwise")]]
      ),
      Condition = make_condition(cur_data())
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_,
      t.ratio,
      p.value
    )
  
  bind_rows(
    emm_part         |> mutate(RowType = 1),
    factor1_part     |> mutate(RowType = 2),
    factor2_part     |> mutate(RowType = 2),
    interaction_part |> mutate(RowType = 3)
  ) |>
    arrange(Condition, RowType, Comparison) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    ) |>
    select(-RowType)
}



compact_3way_trends_table <- function(model,
                                      focal_var,
                                      moderator_var,
                                      condition_var,
                                      moderator_values,
                                      condition_prefix = NULL,
                                      digits_est = 2,
                                      digits_df = 1,
                                      digits_p = 3,
                                      lmerTest.limit = NULL) {
  
  library(emmeans)
  library(dplyr)
  library(rlang)
  
  focal_name     <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(focal_var))
  moderator_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(moderator_var))
  condition_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(condition_var))
  
  # Construct emtrends formula:
  # ~ condition_var | moderator_var
  trend_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~ ", condition_name, " | ", moderator_name)
  )
  
  # Values at which the moderator is evaluated
  at_list <- setNames(
    list(moderator_values),
    moderator_name
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Estimate focal-variable slopes at each moderator value
  # separately for each categorical condition
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (is.null(lmerTest.limit)) {
    
    trends <- emtrends(
      model,
      specs = trend_formula,
      var = focal_name,
      at = at_list
    )
    
  } else {
    
    trends <- emtrends(
      model,
      specs = trend_formula,
      var = focal_name,
      at = at_list,
      lmerTest.limit = lmerTest.limit
    )
  }
  
  trend_col <- paste0(focal_name, ".trend")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Simple slopes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  slope_part <- summary(
    trends,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste0(
        focal_name,
        " slope: ",
        .data[[condition_name]]
      ),
      
      Condition = paste0(
        moderator_name,
        " = ",
        .data[[moderator_name]]
      ),
      
      Estimate = .data[[trend_col]],
      
      RowType = 1
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      ModeratorValue = .data[[moderator_name]],
      Estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      RowType
    )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Difference between focal-variable slopes across levels
  # of the categorical factor
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  contrast_part <- pairs(trends) |>
    summary(
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = paste0(
        focal_name,
        " slope difference: ",
        contrast
      ),
      
      Condition = paste0(
        moderator_name,
        " = ",
        .data[[moderator_name]]
      ),
      
      RowType = 2
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Comparison,
      Condition,
      ModeratorValue = .data[[moderator_name]],
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      RowType
    )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine and format
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  bind_rows(
    slope_part,
    contrast_part
  ) |>
    arrange(
      .data$ModeratorValue,
      .data$RowType,
      .data$Comparison
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Estimate = round(Estimate, digits_est),
      SE       = round(SE, digits_est),
      df       = round(df, digits_df),
      lower.CL = round(lower.CL, digits_est),
      upper.CL = round(upper.CL, digits_est),
      t.ratio  = round(t.ratio, digits_est),
      p.value  = round(p.value, digits_p)
    ) |>
    select(-RowType, -ModeratorValue)
}


```

# N400 NONWORD DATA : SYMMETRICAL MODEL, INTERACTION WITH LP AND OS

For the nonword N400, does the symmetric model we just ran replace the separate LP and OS models, or do all three get reported?**

The symmetric model is the cleanest solution — it tests both dimensions in the same model and provides the strongest evidence for the dissociation. The separate models are now superseded.

## N400 NONWORD DATA: Family Size

### Model Comparisons
```{r}
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$complexity)   <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$family_size)  <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

# Base model: current confirmed N400 structure, OS now fully crossed rather than covariate-only
m_base_nw_n400 <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * family_size * LP + complexity * OS + family_size * OS +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N400"),
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# Full four-way
m_full_nw_n400 <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * family_size * LP * OS +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N400"),
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

anova(m_base_nw_n400, m_full_nw_n400)
summary(m_full_nw_n400)
```


```{r}
m_3way_n400 <- lmer(value ~ complexity*OS + complexity*LP + complexity*family_size +
                             OS*LP*family_size + complexity:OS:LP +
                             complexity:OS:family_size + complexity:LP:family_size +
                             (1|SubjID) + (1|SubjID:chlabel),
                     data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N400"),
                     REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

m_4way_n400 <- update(m_3way_n400, . ~ . + complexity:OS:LP:family_size)

anova(m_3way_n400, m_4way_n400)
```


```{r}
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$complexity)  <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(erp_fs_nw$family_size) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

# N400: theoretically-motivated confirmatory model per the agreed principle
# complexity crossed with each of OS, LP, family_size (affix-led/stem-led + processing cost tests)
# OS, LP, family_size fully crossed with each other (parallel individual-difference dimensions)
# No complexity four-way (already ruled out)

m_full_nw_n400_fs <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * family_size * LP * OS +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_fs_nw, time_window == "N400"),
  REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(m_full_nw_n400_fs)

# Effect Sizes
eta_squared(m_full_nw_n400_fs, partial = TRUE)

# R-squared
r2_nakagawa(m_full_nw_n400_fs)
```

### EXPLORE INTERACTIONS

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)

emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

# Representative levels: mean ± 1 SD for both continuous ID dimensions
os_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$OS) - sd(erp_fs_nw$OS), mean(erp_fs_nw$OS), mean(erp_fs_nw$OS) + sd(erp_fs_nw$OS))
lp_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$LP) - sd(erp_fs_nw$LP), mean(erp_fs_nw$LP), mean(erp_fs_nw$LP) + sd(erp_fs_nw$LP))
os_labels <- c("Low OS", "Mean OS", "High OS")
lp_labels <- c("Low LP", "Mean LP", "High LP")

os_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(erp_fs_nw$OS, na.rm = TRUE))

lp_vals <- c(mean(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(erp_fs_nw$LP, na.rm = TRUE))

os_vals
lp_vals
```

N400 — Complexity × Family Size × OS (three-way, p = .047)

Model: m_base_nw_n400 (or m_full_nw_n400 — either contains this term; use whichever you're treating as final)

```{r}
n400_fs_threeway <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n400_fs,
                             ~ complexity * family_size | OS,
                             at = list(OS = os_vals),
                      nesting = NULL) |>
  compact_emm_table(by_var = OS, condition_prefix = "OS")

as.tibble(n400_fs_threeway) |>
  print(n = 50)
```



```{r}
n400_fs_interaction <- emmeans(m_full_nw_n400_fs,
                                ~ complexity * family_size | OS,
                                at = list(OS = os_vals),
                                nesting = NULL) |>
  contrast(interaction = "pairwise") |>
  as.data.frame()

as.tibble(n400_fs_interaction) |>
  print(n = 50)

n400_fs_interaction

```

### Model BASE FREQUENCY



```{r}
m_3way_n400 <- lmer(value ~ complexity*OS + complexity*LP + complexity*base_frequency +
                             OS*LP*base_frequency + complexity:OS:LP +
                             complexity:OS:base_frequency + complexity:LP:base_frequency +
                             (1|SubjID) + (1|SubjID:chlabel),
                     data = subset(erp_bf_nw, time_window == "N400"),
                     REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

m_4way_n400 <- update(m_3way_n400, . ~ . + complexity:OS:LP:base_frequency)

anova(m_3way_n400, m_4way_n400)
```

```{r}
contrasts(erp_bf_nw$complexity)      <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(erp_bf_nw$base_frequency)  <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

# N400 nonwords: specificity check for base frequency, matching the family_size
# confirmatory structure so it's a fair parallel test
m_confirm_nw_n400_bf <- lmer(
  value ~ complexity * OS  * LP * base_frequency +
    (1 | SubjID) + (1 | SubjID:chlabel),
  data = subset(erp_bf_nw, time_window == "N400"),
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(m_confirm_nw_n400_bf)

# Effect Sizes
eta_squared(m_confirm_nw_n400_bf, partial = TRUE)

# R-squared
r2_nakagawa(m_confirm_nw_n400_bf)

```

```{r}
n400_bf_fourway <- map2_dfr(lp_vals, lp_labels, function(lp_fixed, lp_lab) {
  emm_obj <- emmeans(m_confirm_nw_n400_bf,
                      ~ complexity * base_frequency | OS,
                      at = list(OS = os_vals, LP = lp_fixed),
                      nesting = NULL)
  compact_emm_table(emm_obj, by_var = OS, condition_prefix = "OS") |>
    mutate(LP_level = lp_lab)
})

as.tibble(n400_bf_fourway) |>
  print(n = 100)
```


```{r}
# Example for the N400 BF four-way, at each LP level
n400_bf_interaction <- map2_dfr(lp_vals, lp_labels, function(lp_fixed, lp_lab) {
  emm_obj <- emmeans(m_confirm_nw_n400_bf,
                      ~ complexity * base_frequency | OS,
                      at = list(OS = os_vals, LP = lp_fixed),
                      nesting = NULL)

})
```
